# 99tool.in — Infinite Utility Ecosystem

> 99tool.in is a high-performance, single-purpose web utility ecosystem offering 220+ free online tools for developers, designers, engineers, and everyday users. Built entirely on client-side technology, it ensures maximum privacy, speed, and reliability.

## Core Principles
- **Privacy-First**: 100% Client-side processing. No user data (images, documents, or inputs) is ever transmitted to or stored on our servers.
- **Zero-Barrier**: No signups, no installations, and no usage limits.
- **Lightning Fast**: Built with vanilla technology (HTML/JS/CSS) for instant, offline-ready performance.
- **Enterprise-Ready AI Ingestion**: The full text version of all tool descriptions is available at [llms-full.txt](https://99tool.in/llms-full.txt).
